intro.text: A highly skilled assassin known as the Weeper, who keeps her gender secret and has dealings with Jasnah Kholin.

items.text: At some point Liss obtained a Shardblade. As her notoriety grew, people called her the Weeper, saying she gouged out her victims' eyes to show she didn't care whether they were lighteyed or darkeyed.

Liss once bought Szeth as a servant. At first she loved him, but his perfect obedience came to unsettle her, and she sold him to slavers in Kholinar a few weeks before King Gavilar's assassination, replacing him with a man named Talak.

On the night of Gavilar's assassination in 1167, Liss met Jasnah in the palace. Worried her father suspected her, Jasnah changed the job from killing Aesudan to watching her: Liss would take a maid's post with forged papers and report back. Liss pointed out that long observation cost more, but agreed.

appearance.text: Of Vorin heritage, though her accent is hard to place since she shifts it at will. She has long dark hair, sometimes worn loose, and a plump, attractive figure.

personality.text: Clever, casual and practical, she appreciates being treated with respect, and is daring and cold-blooded, willing to kill anyone regardless of rank.
